scope: Retain nonnegative signed-16-bit LTYPE DXF group-74 values on input while preserving the existing modeled-output limit and DWG validation path.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_LType::parseCode previously rejected group-74 values above 0x0F and assigned the field before completing validation. The DXF group-code type table places group 74 in the 60-79 range, encoded as a 16-bit integer. DRW_LType::validateDxf independently limits typed output to the currently modeled 0x0F range.

normativeEvidence.source: Autodesk AutoCAD 2024 DXF Group Code Value Types Reference
normativeEvidence.relevantRule: Group codes 60-79 use a 16-bit integer value.
LTYPE group 74 is the complex-element type and the reference documents bits 1, 2 and 4; it does not define the higher group-74 values implemented by this generated tolerance control.

implementationReadiness.change: The DXF parser validates group 74 into a temporary, accepts values 0 through INT16_MAX, and assigns only after validation. Existing DXF typed validation and writer admission remain limited to 0x0F. DWG parsing and validation were not changed.

coverage: ASCII and Binary readers retain group-74 values 0, 8, 15, 16 and 32767 without changing their value.
The typed LTYPE model and writer continue admitting the existing 0..15 range and refuse 16 and 32767 before emitting bytes.
Negative values are rejected without mutating the previous typed value in ASCII and Binary DXF.
ASCII group-74 value 32768 is rejected without mutating the previous typed value.

broaderCohort.result: The new LTYPE selector and directly related domain/retained-owner tests passed. Two MLINE/LTYPE adapter selectors failed at the same source lines and with the same counters when rebuilt and run with src/drw_objects.cpp restored from baseline HEAD 7b7defe0; classified as pre-existing and unrelated.

limitations: Generated parser-tolerance controls only; values above 0x0F are retained but not interpreted or writable through the typed LTYPE path.
No physical producer or native CAD acceptance was established for higher group-74 values.
No DWG LTYPE layout or validation behavior was changed.
No support claim is promoted; broader LTYPE profiles and P6 semantics remain open.
nextReadyPacket: Continue with an independently source-backed local P6 gap. Keep unknown DXF values readable only when their group-code encoding is valid, and preserve fail-closed typed output for unmodeled semantics.
